# Globe assets

- `earth-night.jpg`: NASA Earth Observatory "Black Marble" night lights, 4096×2048 equirectangular (public domain), the copy distributed with three-globe's examples.
- `land-50m.json`: world-atlas 2.0.2 (ISC, `LICENSE-world-atlas`), TopoJSON of Natural Earth 1:50m land (public domain). Only its arcs are drawn, as coastlines.
